updates.dailyHint: Asks GitHub for the newest release. Off: only when you press the button.
updates.text: Whether a newer version of nexnotes is out.
updates.title: Updates
updates.whatGoesOut: Only the question goes out: a request to api.github.com for the newest release of nexnotes, with no names, notes or settings. It is the only call nexnotes makes on its own.

block.text: The account is signed out on every device at once and cannot get back in. Its notes stay, and what it shared stays visible to the others.
block.title: Block {{name}}?

delete.text: The account has {{notes}}, {{shared}} of them. It is blocked at once, and what it shared disappears for the others. For {{days}} days you can bring it back; after that it is deleted for good with all its notes.
delete.title: Delete {{name}}?

resetFactor.text: The account then signs in with its password only and can set up a new second factor.
resetFactor.title: Reset the second factor of {{name}}?

restore.text: The account can sign in again, with all its notes.
restore.title: Bring {{name}} back?

role.title: Change the role of {{name}}?
role.toMember: The account becomes a member and runs nothing from now on.
role.toOperator: The account becomes an operator and runs the server and the accounts from now on, without seeing anybody else's notes.

signOut.text: Every session of this account ends. It can sign in again afterwards.
signOut.title: Sign {{name}} out everywhere?

unblock.text: The account can sign in again.
unblock.title: Unblock {{name}}?

unlink.text: The account no longer signs in through {{name}} afterwards.
unlink.title: Unlink {{name}}?

accounts.inviteEmailHint: Optional. With an address nexnotes can mail the link too.
accounts.inviteLink: Send this link to the person. It works once and is shown only now.
accounts.lead_one: {{count}} account. As the operator you see storage and use, but no notes.
accounts.lead_other: {{count}} accounts. As the operator you see storage and use, but no notes.
accounts.limitText: Once reached, writing goes on, new attachments do not.
accounts.resetLinkShown: Send this link to {{name}}. It works once and is shown only now.
accounts.resetLinkText: With this link {{name}} sets a new password themselves; you never learn it. Until then the old one stays. Using the link signs the account out everywhere and ends its paired devices, and at the next sign-in it is told that its password was reset through your link.
accounts.title: Accounts

code.hint: Six digits, or a recovery code from paper.
code.label: Code
code.text: The code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
code.title: Second factor

invite.expiredText: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
invite.haveAccount: You are signed in as {{name}} already.
invite.invalidText: This invitation has been used already or was withdrawn.
invite.noWay: No account can be made here right now. Ask the operator.
invite.text: Create your account, then you can start.
invite.textBy: {{by}} invites you to nexnotes. Create your account, then you can start.
invite.title: Invitation to nexnotes

login.ended: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
login.forgotText: The operator can make you a link in the settings under “Accounts”, with which you set a new password yourself.
login.noAccount: No account? Ask the operator for an invitation.
login.title: Sign in to nexnotes

reset.doneText: Sign in with your new password now.
reset.expiredText: This link has expired. Ask the operator for a new one.
reset.invalidText: This link has been used already or was replaced by a newer one.
reset.text: For {{name}}. Every session and paired device of the account ends; afterwards you sign in with the new password.
reset.title: Set a new password

connections.empty: This is where you will connect iPhone and iPad, nextasks and AI tools (MCP), and manage the vault password.

leave.hint: If the tab is closed anyway, the suggestion is used. Nothing is lost.
leave.text: You are leaving the note. Give it a title, or use the suggestion; it is marked “Check title” until you confirm it once.
leave.title: This note needs a title

link.invalid: Only addresses with http, https or mailto become links.
link.title: Link

editor.offline: Connection lost. What you write stays in this window and is sent as soon as the server is back.

stopped.broken: The server did not accept this change. Reload the page.
stopped.forbidden: You no longer have access to this note. What has not arrived is not saved.
stopped.gone: This note was deleted and is in the trash.
stopped.tooLarge: This note has grown too large. The last change was not saved.

editor.titleRequired: The note cannot be closed without a title.

errors.fresh_sign_in_required: For this, sign in at your provider once more first: operator acts need a sign-in from the last {{minutes}} minutes. You come back here afterwards.
errors.account_blocked: This account is blocked. Ask the operator.
errors.account_locked: Too many wrong passwords. The account waits a quarter of an hour.
errors.backup_damaged: The backup is damaged. Nothing was changed.
errors.backup_invalid: This is not a nexnotes backup.
errors.backup_too_new: This backup comes from a newer version of nexnotes. Update nexnotes first.
errors.busy: nexnotes is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot take the operator role from yourself.
errors.client_required: The request did not say which tab sent it. Reload the page.
errors.email_taken: Another account already uses this email address.
errors.folder_into_itself: A folder cannot go into itself or one of its subfolders.
errors.folder_name_missing: Enter a name for the folder.
errors.folder_name_taken: There is already a folder “{{name}}” here.
errors.folder_name_too_long: A folder name has at most {{maximum}} characters.
errors.folder_style_unknown: This symbol or color does not exist.
errors.folder_target_not_allowed: That is not possible: folders cannot go into the inbox, notes only into a folder.
errors.inbox_fixed: The inbox cannot be deleted, renamed or moved.
errors.invalid_account_name: A sign-in name has 2 to 64 characters: letters without accents, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore, no spaces.
errors.invalid_days: Choose one of the offered durations.
errors.invalid_email: This is not an email address.
errors.invalid_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
errors.invite_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.invite_invalid: The invitation ran out or has been used.
errors.last_operator: nexnotes needs at least one operator.
errors.locale_unusable: This language file cannot be used.
errors.log_level_from_environment: The log level is fixed by NEXNOTES_LOG_LEVEL.
errors.mail_failed: The mail server did not accept the mail.
errors.mail_off: No mail server is set up.
errors.no_offer: There is no address to take.
errors.not_found: Not found, or not open to you.
errors.note_id_taken: A note with this id belongs to another account.
errors.oidc_account: This account signs in through the provider.
errors.operator_network: The operator's settings are open only from the home network.
errors.operator_only: Only the operator may do this.
errors.own_second_factor_first: Set up your own second factor first, on your account page.
errors.password_login_off: Signing in with a password is turned off.
errors.password_too_short: The password needs at least {{minimum}} characters.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password is the same as the current one. Choose another.
errors.provider_first: Set up a sign-in provider first, or nobody but you could sign in.
errors.public_url_change: This address changes what authentik knows. Confirm that first.
errors.public_url_invalid: This is not an address nexnotes can use. Check how it is written.
errors.public_url_missing: Mail needs the public address of nexnotes; the operator sets it under Settings.
errors.public_url_needed: nexnotes has no public address yet. Enter it first.
errors.reset_expired: This link has expired. Ask the operator for a new one.
errors.reset_invalid: This link has been used already or was replaced by a newer one.
errors.second_factor_expired: Too many wrong codes, or too long a wait. Start again with your password.
errors.second_factor_setup_required: Set up your second factor first.
errors.second_factor_unavailable: The second factor cannot be checked on this installation. Ask the operator to reset it.
errors.setup_code_wrong: The setup code is wrong. It is in the server log.
errors.storage_full: The data folder is full. Nothing was saved; free some space and try again.
errors.too_large: The file is larger than allowed ({{max_mb}} MB).
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.totp_code_wrong: The code is not right. A code from the app: check the time on your phone. A recovery code works only once.
errors.totp_enabled: The second factor is on already.
errors.totp_enrolment_expired: The setup took too long. Start again.
errors.totp_not_enabled: The second factor is not on.
errors.unknown_language: nexnotes does not have this language.
errors.use_disable: Turn your own second factor off on your account page.
errors.tag_name_invalid: A tag is made of letters, digits, hyphens, underscores or emoji, without spaces, with at least one letter and at most 64 characters.

folders.empty: No folders yet. Create the first one with +.
folders.keys: Arrow keys move, Enter opens, F2 renames, Shift+F10 opens the menu, Delete moves to the trash.
folders.loadFailed: The folders could not be loaded.

move.title: Move “{{name}}”
move.notInside: A folder cannot go into itself or one of its subfolders.

trash.title: Move “{{name}}” to the trash?
trash.keep_one: Everything stays in the trash for {{count}} day and can be brought back from there.
trash.keep_other: Everything stays in the trash for {{count}} days and can be brought back from there.

page.emptyText: Create the first one, or drag notes here from another folder.
page.gone: This folder does not exist or is in the trash.

inbox.name: Inbox
inbox.text: What you captured quickly waits here to be filed. The inbox is always there.
inbox.emptyText: Whatever you capture quickly lands here: shared from another app, dictated or sent over MCP. From here you file it into your folders.
inbox.tip: Tip: you can also drag notes straight onto a folder in the sidebar.

history.copied: The version is now a new note.
history.keepDays_one: Versions stay for {{count}} day, older ones are thinned out. The operator sets how long.
history.keepDays_other: Versions stay for {{count}} days, older ones are thinned out. The operator sets how long.
history.keepYears_one: Versions stay for a year, older ones are thinned out. The operator sets how long.
history.keepYears_other: Versions stay for {{count}} years, older ones are thinned out. The operator sets how long.
history.none: No versions yet. A version is kept once you stop writing for a few minutes.
history.restored: Version of {{when}} restored. The one before is in the history.
history.title: History

home.empty: Your notes appear here. New notes, folders and search come with the next steps.
home.title: Notes

me.emailDeclined: nexnotes no longer asks about this address.
me.emailOffer: A sign-in provider knows you as {{address}}. Should nexnotes take this address?

password.done: Password changed. Other browsers have to sign in again.
password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.

sessions.done: Every other browser is signed out.
sessions.text: Signs you out everywhere except here, for example after losing a phone.

me.setupFirst: The operator requires a second factor. Set it up here, then you can go on.

list.failed: The notes could not be loaded.
list.title: Notes

notes.pick: Pick a note on the left or start a new one.

resetNotice.hint: If that was not you, tell the operator and change your password under “My account”.
resetNotice.text: Your password was reset through a link from the operator.
resetNotice.title: Password reset

server.checkBad: Damaged: this backup cannot be restored.

backup_restore.text: First the current state is backed up, then nexnotes restarts and restores the backup. Everybody signs in again afterwards.
backup_restore.title: Restore this backup?

backup_download.title: Download this backup?
backup_download.text: It contains every note, attachment and account. It is not encrypted.

backup_upload.title: Upload a backup?
backup_upload.text: The file joins the list of backups. Nothing is restored until you confirm it there.

server.languageAdded: Language added. It shows in the account menu after reloading.
server.languagesHint: German and English are built in. Add more as a JSON file; missing texts fall back to English.
server.limitsHint: You set the storage per account under “Accounts”.
server.linkPreviewsHint: The server fetches title and picture of linked pages.
server.logClearText: Every line is removed. New ones come as before.
server.logHint: Four levels. The two deep ones switch themselves off after an hour. Never the content of notes, passwords or keys.
server.mailHint: Only for invitations. Without a server, the link to copy is enough.
server.mcpHint: Members may make keys for AI tools.
server.ocrHint: Languages read in pictures, scans and PDFs.
server.ownSecondFactorFirst: Set up your own second factor first (My account, Security), or you would be the first one who cannot go on. Not affected is whoever signs in through a provider for which “{{trusts}}” is on.

providers.order: Move {{name}}: drag, or the arrow keys

server.proxyUnknown: Requests come through a proxy, but NEXNOTES_TRUSTED_PROXIES is not set. nexnotes then sees everybody as one sender: whoever guesses wrong often slows down everyone signing in from a browser not used here before. Put the proxy's address into NEXNOTES_TRUSTED_PROXIES. If no proxy stands in front of nexnotes, you can ignore this.
server.restarting: nexnotes restarts with the backup. The page reloads in a moment.

restoreTitles.own: Titles are named only for your own notes.

server.secretKept: Kept; type only to change it.
server.shareLinksHint: Members may make read links for people without an account.
server.twoFactorRequiredHint: Every account that signs in with a password must set one up before it gets further. Accounts from a sign-in provider bring the provider's. An account with a password is not affected either when it comes in through a provider for which “{{trusts}}” is on.
server.uploadMaxHint: 100 MB from the start. Counts at once.
server.uploadedHint: Uploaded. It is in the list now: check it first, then restore.

session.blockedText: The operator has blocked your account. Nothing more is saved. Ask the operator.
session.expiredText: Your sign-in has expired. What you wrote stays here and is saved as soon as you are signed in again.

setup.codeHint: It is in the container's log, or you set it yourself.
setup.passwordHint_one: At least {{count}} character. You set up the second factor right afterwards.
setup.passwordHint_other: At least {{count}} characters. You set up the second factor right afterwards.
setup.share: The data folder lies on a network share (NFS or SMB). That can damage notes. A local disk is better.
setup.text: The first account runs the server. You invite more people afterwards.
setup.title: Set up nexnotes

tags.heading: Tags
tags.none: No tags yet. Type #word into a note.
tags.failed: The tags could not be loaded.
tags.mergeAsk: {{tag}} exists already. Both become one tag.
tags.deleteSays_one: {{tag}} goes from one of your notes; the rest of the text stays.
tags.deleteSays_other: {{tag}} goes from {{count}} of your notes; the rest of the text stays.

confirmEmpty.text_one: {{count}} note will be deleted for good.
confirmEmpty.text_other: {{count}} notes will be deleted for good.
confirmEmpty.title: Empty the trash?

confirmPurge.folder: “{{title}}” and everything in it will be deleted for good.
confirmPurge.title: Delete for good?

trash.failed: The trash could not be loaded.
trash.fromGoneToInbox: from {{name}}, which is gone: comes back into the inbox
trash.fromGoneToTop: from {{name}}, which is gone: comes back at the top
trash.goneToInbox: Its folder is gone: comes back into the inbox
trash.goneToTop: Its folder is gone: comes back at the top
trash.keeps_one: Deleted items stay for {{count}} day, then they are gone for good.
trash.keeps_other: Deleted items stay for {{count}} days, then they are gone for good.
trash.title: Trash

twofactor.codesLead: Each one signs you in once, when the phone is not at hand. They are shown only now: copy them or save them as a file, and keep them apart from the phone.
twofactor.disableText: From then on the password alone signs you in. Enter it to turn the second factor off.
twofactor.lowCodes: Few recovery codes left. Create new ones while you can still sign in.
twofactor.passwordHint: Proves it is you at the keyboard.
twofactor.provider: You sign in through the provider; its second factor applies.
twofactor.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
twofactor.renewText: The old recovery codes stop working. Enter your password to create new ones.
twofactor.scan: Scan this code with the app, or type the key below into it. Then enter the code the app shows, and your password.
twofactor.title: Second factor
